ValidationRule.description: Project 790, Req 3: blocks Send To Order Management unless Primary_Proposal_Status__c = Approved (Flow-maintained copy of Primary_Proposal__r.Status). Excluded flows handled via Proposal_Approval_Required__c. Companion to Send_to_OM_Required_Fields.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Send To Order Management"), Proposal_Approval_Required__c, Primary_Proposal_Status__c <> "Approved" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This opportunity has no approved proposal. Submit the primary proposal (Quote) for approval and wait for it to be Approved before sending this order to Order Management.
